title: Global Linearization of Parameterized Nonlinear Systems with Stable Equilibrium Point Using the Koopman Operator
summary: The Koopman operator framework enables global analysis of nonlinear systems through its inherent linearity. This study aims to clarify spectral properties of the Koopman operators for nonlinear systems with control inputs. To this end, we treat the inputs as parameters throughout this paper. We then introduce the Koopman operator for a parameterized dynamical system with a globally exponentially stable equilibrium point and analyze how eigenfunctions of the operator depend on the parameter.
